title: Tower of Nostradamus
summary: The Tower of Nostradamus is one of the Huntik Foundation's bases located in Salon, France. Peter, Billie, and Annette quarter here.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Nostradamus spent many years in the tower, as a base to conduct his work as a visionary dictating his prophecies of the future in the form of quatrains. He left many artifacts in his secret room including his Scrying Glass with three Sentry Triclops Titans to guard it. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Many years later, the tower was swept by the Huntik Foundation and converted into a museum. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

After Stack informed Wilder that the Huntik Foundation were investigating Nostradamus' quatrains, Wilder and his team planned to discover the tower's secrets. Unbeknownst to them, Peter, Billie and Annette were stationed there. After recognizing Hoffman from their files, Billie and Peter tried to stop the Organization team from accessing Nostradamus' secret room. However, they failed and were taken captive. However Annette's emergency distress call managed to reach the Huntik Foundation Council. They were later rescued by Dante Vale's team who, after defeating the Organization, recovered the Scrying Glass which translated the Quatrains and pointed them in the direction of Avalon. [The Tower of Nostradamus]
